<div class="content cms-content scale-font txt-center">
<h1>The Viking Experience</h1>
<p>When it comes to education, Grand View University means business...and biotechnology, and theatre and 40+ other majors and pre-professional programs. No matter which program you choose, you'll be immersed in the Viking culture. Our creative, innovative, hands-on learning style means that no two experiences are the same. It's all about making your education your own. Our theory? Learn what you love and you'll love to learn. <strong><span style="font-size: 1em;">#BeAViking</span></strong></p>
<h4>Leadership Inspired</h4>
<h4>Meaningful Connections</h4>
<h4>Transformational Opportunities</h4>
<p><a class="button" href="http://www.grandview.edu/student-life/campus/viking-experience" target="_self">Explore the Viking experience</a></p>
</div>

<script src="/scripts/twitterfetcher.js?t=636398696988389156"></script>
<script>
    $script.ready("jquery", function () {
        $(document).ready(function () {
            var configList = {
                "profile": { "screenName": 'grandviewuniv' },
                "domId": 'exampleList',
                "maxTweets": 5,
                "enableLinks": false,
                "showInteraction": false,
                "showImages": false,
                "lang": 'en',
                "dataOnly": true,
                "customCallback": populateTpl
            };

            twitterFetcher.fetch(configList);

            function populateTpl(tweets) {
                if (tweets.length > 0) {
                    var txt = "";

                    var html = $.parseHTML(tweets[0].tweet);
                    $.each(html, function (k, v) {
                        var nodename = v.nodeName.toLowerCase();
                        if (nodename == "#text") {
                            txt += $(v).text();
                        }
                        else if (nodename == "a") {
                            var atext = "";
                            $.each($.parseHTML($(v).html()), function(i, j){
                                atext += $(j).text();
                            })

                            if (atext.length > 30) {
                                atext = atext.substring(0, 30) + "...";
                            }

                            $(v).text(atext);

                            //if ($(v).prop("outerHTML").length > 30) {
                            //    txt += $(v).prop("outerHTML").substr(0, 30);
                            //}

                            txt += $(v).prop("outerHTML");
                        }
                    })

                    //console.log(txt);
                    //document.getElementById("twitterfeed").innerHTML = tweets[0].tweet;
                    document.getElementById("twitterFeed1_twitterfeed").innerHTML = txt;
                }
            }
        })
    })
    
</script>
